serviceDescription: bladestack.io provides advisory, implementation engineering, and managed security and compliance services for cloud service providers, federal agencies, defense contractors, and other regulated organizations. Our services support FedRAMP 20x and Rev. 5, DoD cloud impact levels IL4/IL5/IL6, CMMC, FISMA, GovRAMP, TX-RAMP, and related security, privacy, and governance programs. We help teams assess readiness, design and build security capabilities, develop documentation and machine-readable evidence, prepare for independent assessment, expand authorization boundaries, and sustain operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Formal independent assessments are performed by separate assessors; certification and authorization decisions remain with the applicable authorities.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Application-delivered advisory gap assessment with machine-readable import and export, certification class and path alignment, KSI and requirement mapping, capability and evidence gap analysis, and a prioritized implementation roadmap.

KSI-aligned architecture and implementation covering landing zones, identity, network segmentation, logging, vulnerability and configuration management, cryptography, security tooling, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD integration.

servicesOffered.serviceName: FedRAMP 20x Advisory, Certification Materials, and Evidence Automation
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Boundary and responsibility design; Certification Package Overview and Security Decision Record development; schema-aligned JSON; trust repository and trust center implementation; programmatic sharing; and evidence collection, refresh, retention, and exception workflows.

servicesOffered.serviceName: FedRAMP Rev. 5 Gap Assessment and Phase 0 Discovery
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Technical readiness and architecture reviews, control gaps, and remediation planning. Phase 0 Discovery Fast Track develops authorization boundary diagrams, a Control Ownership Matrix, a Remediation Roadmap, and an Architecture Risk Register for the advisory engagement.

servicesOffered.serviceName: FedRAMP Rev. 5 Advisory and Authorization Package Development
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Architecture-specific System Security Plans, implementation statements, policies, procedures, plans, boundary and data-flow diagrams, and supporting evidence, with embedded technical guidance through implementation and authorization preparation.

servicesOffered.serviceName: Bastion Assessment and Independent Validation Support
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Evidence preparation and access coordination, interview and demonstration readiness, assessor requests, finding responses, remediation support, and agency or program communications. Bastion supports the client through review by its separate independent assessor.

servicesOffered.serviceName: Enjinia Blade Division and Bitstream Merc Engineering
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Embedded and on-demand engineering for security architecture, control implementation, infrastructure as code, code and configuration review, security-stack deployment, and remediation of gaps, findings, and vulnerabilities.

servicesOffered.serviceName: bladeRAMP Managed Services, GENJI ConMon, HANZO SecOps, and SRE
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Platform Build and managed operations within the customer's service boundary: GENJI continuous monitoring, evidence, POA&M, applicable ongoing-certification and vulnerability reporting, and annual assessment preparation; HANZO 24/7 security monitoring and incident response; and SRE infrastructure operations, patching, and availability management. Standalone continuous-monitoring advisory is also available.

Readiness, architecture, engineering, and documentation for impact-level or certification-class changes, additional frameworks, new services and regions, boundary changes, and multi-cloud or multi-offering strategies, including significant-change and reassessment planning.

servicesOffered.serviceName: DoD IL4/IL5/IL6 Advisory and FedRAMP Uplift
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Direct DoD provisional-authorization preparation and FedRAMP-to-DoD uplift: CC SRG gap analysis, SSP and addendum development, Cloud eMASS evidence organization, sponsor and reviewer coordination, and BCAP, DoD PKI, SCCA, STIG, and cryptographic implementation support.

servicesOffered.serviceName: CMMC Advisory and CUI Enclave Services
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Defense-contractor FCI/CUI scoping, NIST SP 800-171 readiness, SSP and evidence development, SPRS support, CUI enclave design and deployment, control implementation, C3PAO assessment preparation, and ongoing compliance operations.

Agency-specific categorization, control selection, boundary and inheritance analysis, authorization-package development, engineering, assessment support, and ongoing authorization preparation, including automation and documentation reuse across agencies.

servicesOffered.serviceName: GovRAMP Advisory, Fast Track, and Expansion
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Readiness and package development for state, local, tribal, and education cloud requirements, technical implementation, independent-assessment preparation, reuse of eligible FedRAMP materials through Fast Track, continuous monitoring, and authorization expansion.

servicesOffered.serviceName: TX-RAMP Advisory, Fast Track, and Level Transition
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Texas cloud-service readiness, questionnaire and security-plan development, DIR and SPECTRIM submission support, implementation engineering, reuse of eligible existing certifications, level-transition planning, and ongoing compliance and recertification support.

servicesOffered.serviceName: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Architecture and Engineering
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Platform assessments, landing zones, cloud and government-region architecture, IAM, networking, Kubernetes and serverless security, infrastructure as code, security monitoring, modernization, and managed operations. AWS services also include secure research environments and regulated-data enclaves.

servicesOffered.serviceName: Related Security, Privacy, and AI Governance Advisory
servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Related services cover NIST CSF; ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001; NIST Privacy Framework and AI RMF; HITRUST; HIPAA; GDPR; CCPA/CPRA; IRAP; and TISAX. Engagements include readiness, governance documentation, implementation, and control or evidence reuse where applicable.

Accessibility evaluation, manual and assistive-technology testing, VPAT and Accessibility Conformance Report development, design-system and code remediation, CI/CD checks, and ongoing accessibility maintenance for procurement and product requirements.
